_comment: Mount manifest for reassembling the MetaBuilder dev workspace in CI.
MetaBuilder follows a micro-repo model: this repo holds only three frontends,
while their dependencies live in sibling repos on the same GitHub account.
The npm workspaces in the root package.json, and the QML paths in
frontends/qt6/CMakeLists.txt, both assume a monorepo layout that no longer
exists on disk. This file records how to rebuild that layout.
Consumed by .github/scripts/assemble_workspace.py. Pins are bumped by
Builds take each repo's 'branch' head by default; 'ref' is only used when
something asks to be pinned (--pinned, or floating: false on the action).
So 'ref' is a record of a known-good set and a way to reproduce an older
build -- it is not what a normal build resolves to. Keep it current anyway:
bump-workspace-pins.yml does that through a PR.
Adding a repo: give it a 'branch' (what builds actually follow), a 'ref'
(a commit SHA on that branch), and one or more mounts. 'from' is a path
inside the source repo ('.' for the whole repo); 'to' is the path it lands
at, relative to this repo's root.

repos._note: Also satisfies the libraries/components/m3 workspace: the m3 package lives in this repo's m3/ subdirectory.

Mounted twice on purpose. libraries/redux matches the workspace glob in the root package.json. The bare redux/ is required by the webpack alias in frontends/nextjs/next.config.ts, which resolves '@metabuilder/service-adapters' to path.resolve(monorepoRoot, 'redux/adapters/src') - a root-level path that predates the June 2026 reorg into libraries/. Removing the second mount fails the build with "Can't resolve '@metabuilder/service-adapters'". The cleaner fix is to correct that alias to libraries/redux/adapters/src and drop this mount.

Not an npm workspace - it has no root package.json and nothing depends on it by name. libraries/components reaches it purely by relative path ('../../icons/react/m3'), so grepping for @metabuilder/icons will not reveal this dependency. Omitting it fails the build with 'Module not found: Can't resolve ../../../../icons/react/m3'.
Default branch is master, not main. Only the workflow-lib subdirectory is the @metabuilder/workflow package; the rest of the repo is the workflowui app.

Mounted twice on purpose, because the app disagrees with itself about where this lives: next.config.ts resolves '@dbal-ui' to ../../dbal/shared/ui (root-level), while tsconfig.json maps '@dbal-ui/*' to ../../libraries/dbal/shared/ui/* . Webpack uses the former, tsc the latter, so both paths must exist. In the dbal repo the tree lives under libraries/dbal.
Build-time dependency, not just runtime: frontends/nextjs/scripts/compile-tokens.mjs reads packages/{id}/styles/tokens.json on every build and silently emits an empty stub when absent.
frontends/qt6/CMakeLists.txt references 275 distinct paths under ../../libraries/qml/; all 275 resolve against this repo's qml/ directory.

nextjs._note: npm workspaces + packages/ for design tokens.

qt6._note: QML sources only; Qt itself comes from Conan.

cli._note: Self-contained. Needs no mounts - all sources live under frontends/cli/src and every dependency (cpr, lua, sol2, nlohmann_json) comes from Conan.
